risk_summary: The disclosure presents severe liquidity and solvency risk, including a $159 million working capital deficit, $414 million of short-term borrowings and bills payable, operating cash outflows, and an auditor-identified substantial doubt about going-concern viability. Management relies on continued short-term financing, tax refunds, new product ramp-up, and additional capital, all of which remain uncertain. The text is quantitatively informative but mixes significant risk disclosures with optimistic expansion projections and repeated conditional language.
